## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `IntegrationControlPlane`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `integration-control-plane-icp`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **IntegrationControlPlane**.

## Step 2: Configuring the integration node with ICP

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the home view of WSO2 Integrator. -->
2. Select **Enable ICP monitoring** checkbox under **the **Integration Control Plane** section**.
3. <!-- manual: Enabling ICP monitoring will generate and add the following configurations to your runtime. -->
4. Select **View in ICP** button to start and connect the integration runtime to the ICP server.
5. The ICP server will start on `https://localhost:9446`.

## Step 3: Browsing the ICP

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to https://localhost:9446 in your browser. -->
2. <!-- manual: Enter the default username (admin) and password (admin), then click the Sign In button. :::caution Security Recommendation Default credentials must be changed before using ICP in production. Update the admin password account through Profile › Change Password in the ICP dashboard. ::: -->
3. The project will be displayed on the **Home** page of the ICP dashboard.
4. <!-- manual: Click on the project to view the integrations. -->
5. <!-- manual: Click on an integration to view integration artifacts. -->
